rows.note: Use 結構 as the all-purpose noun for the parts and overall organization of something.

example.english: The structure of this article is very clear.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章嘅結構好清晰。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ge3 git3 kau3 hou2 cing1 sik1

rows.note: Use 架構 for an abstract, organizational, or system framework rather than a physical object.

example.english: The structure of this system still needs changing.
example.traditional: 呢個系統嘅架構仲要再改。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 ge3 gaa3 kau3 zung6 jiu3 zoi3 goi2

rows.note: Use 形狀 when this sense focuses on the external or geometric form of a solid or face.

example.english: The structure of this rock is very unusual.
example.jyutping: ni1 gau6 sek6 ge3 jing4 zong6 hou2 kei4 gwaai3
